d: Kanpur was once called the "Manchester of the East". In this episode of Kissa, Bhupendra Soni tells the story of how a small village on the banks of the Ganga, Kanhpur, became the East India Company's biggest military cantonment in North India after the British defeated the Nawab of Awadh and the Marathas near Jajmau in 1765. The city then became the scene of one of the bloodiest chapters of 1857: the siege of Wheeler's Entrenchment, the Satichaura Ghat massacre, the killings at Bibighar, and the brutal British revenge that followed.
